description: Header file defining the net::IPEndPoint class, which represents a network endpoint with IP address and port, including methods for serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversions.

classes.name: net::IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint with IP address and port, providing methods for address manipulation and socket address conversions.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Creates an IPEndPoint from a base::Value if valid.

methods.name: IPEndPoint(const IPAddress&, uint16_t)
methods.description: Constructor with IP address and port.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the endpoint.

methods.name: GetFamily
methods.description: Returns the address family (IPv4, IPv6, or unspecified).

methods.name: GetForAllInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an endpoint for all interfaces on the specified port (STARBOARD only).

methods.name: FromSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Sets endpoint from a SbSocketAddress (STARBOARD only).

methods.name: GetSockAddrFamily
methods.description: Returns the socket address family (AF_INET, AF_INET6, or AF_BTH).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of endpoint with address and port.

methods.name: ToStringWithoutPort
methods.description: Returns string representation of address without port.
